newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads man for molesting boys.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads man for molesting boys.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded a Saudi man for kidnapping and molesting two young boys, Saudi television quoted an Interior Ministry statement as saying.
It said the man was under the influence of alcohol, banned in Saudi Arabia, and had a previous drug record.
He was the 28th person executed this year in the conservative kingdom that strictly imposes Islamic sharia law by beheading convicted drug smugglers, rapists, murderers and other criminals.
